tools.name: search_vendor_docs
tools.description: Search tracked vendor documents by vendor name or document type. Returns matching records with status (validated, received, missing, overdue) and expiry dates.

tools.name: list_missing_docs
tools.description: List every vendor document that is still missing (not yet received), most critical first — expired/overdue at the top, then by days remaining.

tools.name: get_expiring_docs
tools.description: List vendor documents expiring within the next N days (default 30), including ones already received, so renewals can be requested before they lapse.

tools.name: get_compliance_summary
tools.description: Get the compliance dashboard summary: totals for tracked, missing, expired/overdue, due this week, and awaiting review.

tools.name: export_vendor_report
tools.description: Export the full vendor document report as CSV text (vendor, doc type, due date, status, request history).
